subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw add WhatsApp unauthorized-group auto-leave and group-add notification now, and which admission trigger and authorization contract should govern the destructive leave operation?
rationale: Current source proves the requested behavior is missing, but auto-leave and manual leave change a privacy/security boundary and add new public config/event/action surfaces.

options.title: Design opt-in WhatsApp contract first
options.body: Define group admission, join-event, leave authorization, audit, and owner-notification semantics before implementation.

options.title: Defer to shared group pairing
options.body: Keep this tied to the broader group-pairing design and avoid WhatsApp-specific notification semantics until the shared flow is settled.

options.title: Keep allowlist-only posture
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw should keep dropping unauthorized WhatsApp group traffic and document manual cleanup rather than adding auto-leave.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in WhatsApp contract first
recommendation.body: Define group admission, join-event, leave authorization, audit, and owner-notification semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of recent WhatsApp config/runtime history and prior review context for this item.
